invariants.rationale: data.stream() is called, so data must be non-null.
Function 'func' is used in map(throwingMapToPairWrapper(func)), so it must be non-null.
At most one entry per input; duplicate keys overwrite previous values, so the result map can be at most the number of input elements.
Parallelism may be used to control splitting, commonly > 0 when present.
